issues.title: Primary-text audit incomplete
issues.text: Only Red 81 and the opening train scene are checked against an authorized excerpt. The remaining records are fan-indexed, even when a chapter is attached.

issues.title: Katia drawing descriptions still to be checked
issues.text: Those passages should govern the reconstruction. They have not been retrieved in primary text here; this prototype does not claim to reproduce her drawing. A fan-described figure-eight is used only for the Nightmare circuit.

issues.title: Duplicate labels are editorial
issues.text: 83(a)/83(b) and 283(a)/283(b) identify distinct Nightmare Express stops in its published source order. The letters are ours, not book terminology. Aliases are fixed identifiers, not recalculated when a map is filtered.

issues.title: Matching numbers do not establish a transfer
issues.text: Line context, physical identity, platform and layer must agree. Yard memberships, shared platform identities and layer orientation remain incomplete.

issues.title: Not a continuous position tracker
issues.text: A checkpoint is a reported location within a chapter, not necessarily its end. Unreported movement is unknown. No speed, timetable or continuous animation is fabricated.

issues.title: Not an operational route planner
issues.text: Collisions, closures, reversals and permissions are not comprehensively modeled. Arrows show a reference or reported journey direction, not a guarantee a train currently runs that way.

issues.title: Source conflicts quarantined
issues.text: Mora 82 has inconsistent line columns in the fan index. Station 317 introduces additional color names not reconciled with its roster. Raven Blade Unlimited remains unsubstantiated in the inspected sources. These are not plotted as established facts.

issues.title: Chapter filtering remains provisional
issues.text: Fan chapter references are not verified first-reveal offsets. A shared view has a spoiler gate, but the data is not yet guaranteed spoiler-safe. No audiobook timestamps are provided.

issues.title: Original generated map is discarded
issues.text: The invented central hub, station names and districts from the artwork are not source evidence and are not included.
